dct_description_sm: This dataset contains UAV photogrammetric products, UAV LiDAR point clouds, hand-made tree crown segmentation polygons, and georeferenced tree height and stem diameter measurements in carbon sequestration plantations in Quebec, Canada. The products included in this dataset are RGB orthomosaics, LiDAR and photogrammetry point clouds, digital surface models and processing reports. The tree measurements include species, height, stem diameter and location.

dct_title_s: UAV LiDAR, UAV Imagery, Tree Segmentations and Ground Mesurements for Estimating Tree Biomass in Canadian (Quebec) Plantations
